snippet.title: Empyreal | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Gather your courage, mercenary. It is time to enter the Monolith.  

Empyreal is available now on Steam, PlayStation® 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Prepare yourself by viewing the Official Launch Trailer for this debut action-RPG, from the independent development team at Silent Games.  

In a far-flung corner of the galaxy, Empyreal challenges you to build the ultimate mercenary, tasked with exploring an imposing Monolith, battling ferocious automatons, and uncovering the answers to this universe’s greatest mysteries.  

For more information, follow & Wishlist Empyreal on Steam and stay tuned to Silent Games' social channels for the latest updates.  

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377700/Empyreal/  
Join the Silent Games Discord: https://discord.gg/MPw9pTuJh4  
Follow Silent Games: https://www.silentgames-studio.com/  
Follow Secret Mode: https://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode
